A young girl with brown hair is leaning over the open top of the barrel, with her head and upper torso inside the opening. The barrel has a black rim/lid structure. To the right, there are colorful ropes or fabrics (yellow, orange, blue) piled on the ground. In the background, there is a metal fence, some vegetation, and a blue recycling bin.
